latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of baidu-search skill.

- Enables web search via Baidu AI Search API for live information, documentation, or research topics.
- Requires configuration of a BAIDU_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports advanced search features, including adjustable result count (1–50) and time range filtering.
- Provides detailed usage instructions and example commands.
- Fully functional and ready for use.
